root_cause: Primary defect is in mv_npu_top control/datapath integration: cfg_m/cfg_n and bias/relu enables are decoded from wrong bit positions, compute starts immediately on cfg without enforcing section sequencing, row/output progress is driven by a_lane_valid rather than FSM-defined completion, and output emission does not honor backpressure/row-finalize protocol. This produces early divergence (output count/data mismatch) and later deadlock/timeouts.

first_divergence.expected: Exactly M outputs with correct dot/bias/relu values and final out_last
first_divergence.observed: Example failure shows len(out)=10 vs expected 8; other tests hit job timeout

evidence.observation: Assertion failure: len(out)=10 while expected M=8
evidence.relevance: Direct violation of architectural invariant exactly one output per row
Control/progress protocol can stall or fail to complete jobs

evidence.observation: pack_cfg encodes M in bits[7:0], N in bits[15:8], bias_en bit16, relu_en bit17

evidence.relevance: Deterministic decode mismatch against frozen verifier contract

evidence.observation: Top drives compute_active/start_row locally and ignores ctrl_fsm pulses for sequencing; out emission tied inside a_lane_valid/col_idx path
evidence.relevance: Explains output duplication/loss and timeout under stalls

evidence.observation: Only WIDTHEXPAND warnings, no fatal compile/elab errors
evidence.relevance: Confirms failure is functional simulation, not compile-time

alternative_hypotheses: x_buffer_mem read latency misalignment contributes to arithmetic mismatch
